name: Tindwyl
summary: A Terris Feruchemist of the Synod, sent to Luthadel during the siege to train Elend Venture as a proper leader. Tindwyl is a stern, wise, and no-nonsense elder who forces Elend to confront his weaknesses and grow into the ruler the new empire needs. She is also a Keeper, preserving the wisdom of ancient Terris knowledge. Her relationship with Sazed, built on mutual respect and shared purpose, blossoms into a deep love—making her death at the hands of the Koloss one of the most painful blows Sazed ever endures.
